snippet.title: Horizon Talks Ep. 2: What's Cookin'? (Q2 22)
snippet.description:
Sometimes the stars are brighter than they seem.
Sometimes the world will push you beyond your capabilities.
Sometimes you will need to burn the candle on both ends.
And when the unexpected happens, sometimes you need to improvise.
But no matter the challenge, always remember that whe- rever there’s fire, there’s a feast ready to be cooked.
So when that time comes, what would you do?
